observed.facings.png: Three facings at one shared scale. South and north have almost the same silhouette: a tall, wide triangular mound of olive-tan slug flesh, with the head and eyestalks at the top tip. South's stalks end in dark glossy eye-knobs; north's stalks end in plain knobs, with no eyes. Both show a glowing yellow-green translucent window in the middle of the mound, holding a wooden crate, a metal canister crumbling into granules and a bone dissolving into foam. In south the crate is at the bottom and the bone at the top. In north the crate is at the top and the bone at the bottom. East is a long, low side profile of a slug: tail on the left, head raised on the right with two eyestalks, and a translucent lower flank showing crate (rear), canister (middle) and bone remnant (front) in a row. East is much lower and longer than the south/north mounds.
observed.south.png: The triangular mound at full resolution. The head sits at the apex with two eyestalks and dark eyes facing the viewer. The body spreads wide and low toward the bottom edge, so the widest, nearest part of the body is below and in front of the head. A glowing gut window shows a crate (lower), a canister (middle) and a bone (upper). The outline is painterly with a dark rim. Clean alpha.
observed.east.png: A side profile of a long slug with a rippled mantle. The head is lifted on the right with eyestalks. A translucent belly panel along the lower flank shows three objects in a row: an intact crate, a half-dissolved canister, and a bone almost gone to foam. Clean alpha, no ground shadow.
observed.north.png: The same tall triangular mound as south, with eyestalks at the top that have knobs but no eyes. The back has wrinkled ridges and a glowing translucent area showing crate (top), canister (middle) and dissolving bone (bottom). No face. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the slug (east view) is about 1.8 cells long and about as tall as the vanilla human's head-and-torso. NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows the wrinkled back, with eyestalks as eyeless knobs at the top. No face or eyes.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: South and north are both a triangle with the head at the apex and the body's length running up the canvas. This is a high overhead or oblique-from-behind projection, not the game's angled camera. That is why both are about twice as tall as the east profile.

SIGNATURE.seen: A glowing translucent belly with three swallowed objects at different stages of dissolution is clearly legible on all three facings.

ALIEN.seen: The body shape is a plain Earth slug, but the glowing see-through gut with three digesting objects is present and striking. 3 of the 4 departures are present.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1 house-sized: ABSENT. The crate is tailward in east, but appears nearest the viewer at the bottom of south and farthest away at the top of north. observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard. South: a swollen, pale flesh-coloured dome mottled with red blotches and fine veins, with a ring of rounded bulbous nodules around its lower rim. A single large red eye with a slit pupil and wrinkled lids sits front-centre under the dome. Six or so ringed, octopus-like tentacles hang below, and a soft pink-red mist drifts down beneath them. East: the same dome in profile with the eye at the right front, low on the body. The tentacles trail back and down to the left, and the red mist drifts under and behind. North: the dome from behind, with a row of rim nodules (a large central one) and tentacles and mist below. No eye or face. Sizes match closely.
observed.south.png: Front view: a fleshy, mottled gas-bag dome with one centred red slit-pupil eye low on its front, bulbous rim lobes, curling tentacles and a reddish haze plume below. Clean alpha, painterly rendering.
observed.east.png: Side profile: the dome leans forward, with the eye at the front-lower right looking forward and slightly down. Tentacles stream back to the lower left, and red mist drifts beneath. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: Rear view: the back of the dome with veining and red blotches, a row of rim nodules, tentacles and haze below. No eye visible.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the creature is about two cells wide, much larger than the human, a big floating mass. At 32 px/cell it reads as a pale pink blob with a darker underside and a pink smudge. The eye is barely legible at that size.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the eye front-centre, facing the camera, with tentacles hanging below: a front view.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows the back of the dome and the rim nodules, with no eye and no face.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three are side-on or slightly high views of a floating body, not top-down.

SAME_SIZE.seen: The measured spread is 4%. All three look the same size in facings.png.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: Same dome, palette, rim nodules, tentacles and haze on every facing. The eye is front on south, front-right on east and hidden on north, so it turns with the body.

SIGNATURE.seen: A gas-filled floating shape with a watching eye and a reddish haze breathed beneath it. All of this is legible.

ALIEN.seen: A single cyclopean eye under a veined gas dome, with nodule rim lobes and a red haze. A stranger would not name it as an Earth octopus or jellyfish at first glance.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1) Floats in open air: there is no water or ground, the tentacles dangle and the haze falls, so it reads as airborne (canopy height cannot be shown in a sprite). 2) A swollen, opaque, inflated dome, not a thin translucent bell: present. 3) A prominent eye: present. It sits low on the body and looks slightly downward on east, but on south it looks mostly straight out. 4) A reddish haze drifting beneath: present on all facings.

STYLE.seen: Painterly, realistic fleshy texture, veins and mottling, and a grim reptilian slit eye. Not cute or cel-shaded.

OURS.seen: Original generated art. No vanilla or other-mod animal is recognisable.

ALPHA.seen: Clean cut-out. The only soft pixels are the haze, which is part of the subject; there is no ground patch or shadow.

SCALE.seen: About two cells across beside the human: a large drifting shape. The description gives no small-size words, so this is consistent.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px it reads as a pale dome over a darker fringe and a pink smudge, distinct from the ground. The eye is lost, but the silhouette holds.
